info.name: ArgueBot local conversation service
info.description: Runnable local contract coverage. Set baseUrl, pairingCode or token. State-creating requests use fictional records. Model execution, settings changes and restart require allowExecution=true; use the committed local simulation before enabling it. Generated from assets/api-contract.json and the typed C# DTOs.

exec: if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('History page is bounded with membership metadata',()=>{const page=pm.response.json();pm.expect(page.items.length).to.be.at.most(page.pageSize);pm.expect(page.throughSequence).to.be.at.most(page.latestSequence);});

item.name: Create complete recovery archive

request.description: Requires an active bearer session. May execute work or change service state; do not blindly replay requests. Mutation permission required; service settings/restart require administrator. Create complete recovery archive

exec: if(pm.response.code<300) { const job=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('backupId',job.backupId); pm.test('Recovery state is explicit',()=>pm.expect(['queued','running','completed','failed']).to.include(job.state)); pm.test('Passphrase is absent from job metadata',()=>pm.expect(job).not.to.have.property('password')); }
